approach.en: Start with an everyday payment, then explain what shielding protects.

en.sentence: Zcash is digital money that keeps the sender, recipient and amount of shielded payments out of public view.
en.30s: When you pay someone in cash, you do not hand every passerby a copy of the payment. Zcash brings that expectation to the internet. It is digital money with shielded transfers that protect the sender, recipient and amount from public view. Zcash also supports transparent transfers, so the wallet and payment type matter.
en.60s: When you pay someone in cash, you do not hand every passerby a copy of the payment. Zcash brings that expectation to the internet. It is digital money with shielded transfers that protect the sender, recipient and amount from public view. Zcash also supports transparent transfers, so the wallet and payment type matter. Imagine paying a friend for lunch. You want your friend to receive the money, without publishing the details for strangers. A shielded payment helps with that. It is still a blockchain transaction, with fees and confirmation time. The cash comparison explains confidentiality; it does not mean there is no record or that your device and internet connection become invisible.

pt-BR.sentence: Zcash leva uma ideia do dinheiro em espécie aos pagamentos online: transferências shielded não expõem remetente, destinatário e valor no registro público.
pt-BR.30s: Ao pagar alguém em dinheiro, você não entrega uma cópia do pagamento a cada pessoa que passa. Zcash leva essa expectativa à internet. É dinheiro digital com transferências shielded, que protegem remetente, destinatário e valor da exposição pública. Zcash também permite transferências transparentes, então a carteira e o tipo de pagamento importam.
pt-BR.60s: Ao pagar alguém em dinheiro, você não entrega uma cópia do pagamento a cada pessoa que passa. Zcash leva essa expectativa à internet. É dinheiro digital com transferências shielded, que protegem remetente, destinatário e valor da exposição pública. Zcash também permite transferências transparentes, então a carteira e o tipo de pagamento importam. Imagine pagar a um amigo sua parte do almoço. Você quer que ele receba o dinheiro, sem publicar os detalhes para desconhecidos. Um pagamento shielded ajuda nisso. Ainda é uma transação em blockchain, com taxas e tempo de confirmação. A comparação explica a confidencialidade; não significa ausência de registro nem que seu dispositivo e sua conexão se tornem invisíveis.

Zcash también permite transferencias transparentes, así que la billetera y el tipo de pago importan.

en.sentence: If Bitcoin introduced you to peer-to-peer money, Zcash adds a different possibility: payments whose sensitive details can stay shielded.
en.30s: Bitcoin makes transaction data publicly inspectable. Zcash is a separate network and currency that also supports peer-to-peer payments, but adds shielded transfers. The network can check those payments without publishing the sender, recipient and amount. Think of 'Bitcoin, but private' as an opening analogy, not a claim that ZEC is bitcoin or that every Zcash transfer is private.
en.60s: Bitcoin makes transaction data publicly inspectable. Zcash is a separate network and currency that also supports peer-to-peer payments, but adds shielded transfers. The network can check those payments without publishing the sender, recipient and amount. Think of 'Bitcoin, but private' as an opening analogy, not a claim that ZEC is bitcoin or that every Zcash transfer is private. For example, a public address used to receive payment can expose related activity. Shielding changes what is visible on the blockchain. You still need to check that both sides of the payment use shielded support. Public records do not automatically identify a person, and shielding does not erase information already disclosed through exchanges, websites or conversations.

pt-BR.sentence: Se Bitcoin apresentou a você o dinheiro entre pessoas, Zcash acrescenta outra possibilidade: pagamentos cujos detalhes sensíveis podem ficar protegidos.
pt-BR.30s: Bitcoin torna os dados das transações públicos. Zcash é outra rede e outra moeda, que também permite pagamentos entre pessoas, mas acrescenta transferências shielded. A rede pode verificar esses pagamentos sem publicar remetente, destinatário e valor. Pense em 'Bitcoin, mas privado' como uma analogia inicial, não como uma afirmação de que ZEC é bitcoin ou de que toda transferência Zcash é privada.

Registros públicos não identificam automaticamente uma pessoa, e essa proteção não apaga informações já divulgadas por corretoras, sites ou conversas.

en.sentence: Zcash uses zero-knowledge proofs so the network can verify shielded payments without learning their private details.
en.30s: A payment network needs to reject invalid spending, but that does not require publishing every payment detail. Zcash uses zero-knowledge proofs: cryptographic evidence that a transaction follows rules without revealing the private inputs to the proof. Combined with the rest of the protocol, they let the network validate shielded payments while protecting the sender, recipient and amount.
en.60s: A payment network needs to reject invalid spending, but that does not require publishing every payment detail. Zcash uses zero-knowledge proofs: cryptographic evidence that a transaction follows rules without revealing the private inputs to the proof. Combined with the rest of the protocol, they let the network validate shielded payments while protecting the sender, recipient and amount. Think of a public check that an accounting rule holds, without opening each private entry to the world. Validators verify proofs and other consensus conditions, including protections against double spending. The protocol still exposes some information, such as transaction fees. It is not magic encryption of the entire internet, and a proof of a valid payment does not establish a person's identity or intentions.

pt-BR.sentence: Zcash usa provas de conhecimento zero para que a rede verifique pagamentos shielded sem conhecer seus detalhes privados.

Zcash usa provas de conhecimento zero: evidências criptográficas de que uma transação segue regras sem revelar as entradas privadas da prova. Combinadas com o restante do protocolo, elas permitem validar pagamentos shielded e proteger remetente, destinatário e valor.

en.sentence: A shielded Zcash donation can support a cause without publishing the donor's payment details on the blockchain.
en.30s: Supporting a community should not require publishing your financial life to everyone. Zcash offers shielded payments that keep sensitive transaction details out of the public blockchain record. For a donation, that can give the donor and organization room to decide what to share. It is a way to discuss privacy through everyday dignity and choice, rather than through secrecy alone.
en.60s: Supporting a community should not require publishing your financial life to everyone. Zcash offers shielded payments that keep sensitive transaction details out of the public blockchain record. For a donation, that can give the donor and organization room to decide what to share. It is a way to discuss privacy through everyday dignity and choice, rather than through secrecy alone. An organization might publish its mission and reports while using a shielded receiving address. The donor and recipient still have their own records, and a website or payment service may collect information separately. Shielding does not promise safety in every situation. Clear communication about the receiving method, record keeping and disclosures remains part of a responsible donation process.

en.sentence: Shielded Zcash payments help businesses avoid publishing payment amounts and counterparties to the public blockchain.
en.30s: A business may want to accept a payment without making its customer relationships or supplier amounts public. Zcash supports shielded transfers, keeping sensitive payment details off the public blockchain while the network verifies the transaction. That can be useful when discussing commercial confidentiality. The business still needs its own records and a payment workflow that actually supports shielding.
en.60s: A business may want to accept a payment without making its customer relationships or supplier amounts public. Zcash supports shielded transfers, keeping sensitive payment details off the public blockchain while the network verifies the transaction. That can be useful when discussing commercial confidentiality. The business still needs its own records and a payment workflow that actually supports shielding. Picture a small studio paying a contractor. The invoice can stay between the parties instead of becoming a public map of the studio's activity. Zcash does not replace invoicing, accounting or agreements, and services used around the payment may retain data. The useful distinction is between keeping records for the people who need them and broadcasting those records to everyone.

en.sentence: Think of a shielded Zcash payment as an envelope: its contents are for the people involved, while the network can still check the payment.
en.30s: A postcard leaves its message open to anyone handling it. An envelope gives a different expectation of privacy. It does not mean the entire transaction disappears, or that Zcash is a bank account.

pt-BR.60s: Um histórico de pagamentos pode revelar rotinas e relações quando ligado a outros dados. Zcash ajuda a reduzir uma fonte dessa exposição. A proteção shielded reduz os detalhes disponíveis na própria blockchain. Não impede que uma loja mantenha registros de compras nem que um site colete informações da conta. IA é um tema útil para a conversa, mas o exemplo não mede suas capacidades nem afirma que Zcash vence toda técnica de análise. O princípio prático é expor menos dados desnecessários.

es.sentence: Un pago blindado deja menos datos sensibles de la transacción en la cadena pública para que otros los analicen y combinen.
es.30s: Un historial de pagos puede revelar rutinas y relaciones cuando se vincula con otros datos. Zcash ayuda a reducir una fuente de esa exposición. Las transferencias totalmente blindadas mantienen el remitente, el destinatario y el importe fuera de la cadena pública. Esto importa tanto para análisis humanos como para software convencional o IA. Es minimización de datos, no una garantía contra la creación de perfiles.
